scope: Only one-control-tick request/slew/VMC calculations at the same512 saved public-encoder states. No environment construction/integration, physics or policy inference.

fixture.geometry_during_tick: fixed, so any observed order/rate issue does not require moving geometry

arms: reset_geometry: identical latent/filter and original361 request(r_reset,a_next), then VMC at r_current; r_reset from same accepted public reset packet
wrong_order_diagnostic: original361 request at a_prev/target with current r, then independently slew six canonical coordinates by .01
original_D3_scale_reference: same latent_next numerically embedded into originalD3, not claimed same latent physical directions
preregistered_checks: live requested common-force component<=1e-10N; |Hsum|<=.1+1e-12Nm; Box<=1+1e-12; wheel sum0
live and reset maps bitwise identical at each saved reset geometry for all27targets/4previous states
cold a_prev=0,a_target=0 returns0; nonzero previous latent is not expected to withdraw instantly
report any mapped canonical per-tick increment exceeding old .01; do not change latent rate after observing it
report wrong-order force leakage; do not treat it as installed-controller failure
compute deterministic grid six-motor RMS through common public polar Jacobians for all4arms; ratios are not Gaussian/PPO exploration equivalence
information_contract: Same actor physical packet and causal total-command history; any future implementation must version action-memory semantics. Live canonical telemetry contains current low-level geometry, so do not append it unconditionally as extra delay-free actor information. Matched Cart live/reset arms need identical latent-memory telemetry; old D3/V6 comparisons must disclose semantic changes and use same obtainable measurements.
deployment_gate: The361 law is not a drop-in old virtual6 wrapper. This audit cannot admit the full native Nom/joint-guard/motor-envelope chain or closed-loop task. No runtime until a matched versioned interface and complete delivered-command check exists.
allowed_interpretation: Distinguish geometry update from Cartesian chart, slew coordinates and scaling. Same Box is insufficient for equal effective authority/exploration. Actual benefit remains untested.
